premise: This forensic investigation traces the genealogical labyrinth of the Hitler family from 19th-century peasant roots in the Waldviertel to the deliberate pact made by surviving relatives to extinguish their own bloodline. Utilizing declassified intelligence dossiers, wartime medical records, and primary genealogical archives, we uncover the biological reality behind the dictator and the modern remnants of a cursed legacy.
